name: GoodCompound
fix_description: In maxSafeTokenAmount, pair.getReserves() returns the instantaneous reserve which can be manipulated via flash loans. Fix: use a TWAP oracle or time-weighted reserve values instead of spot reserves to determine the safe swap amount. Alternatively, add a slippage check or compare against a cached/historical reserve value.
difficulty_reasoning: The exploit is more than a trivial single-bug case: it uses a flash loan, interacts with a specific AMM pair, and relies on understanding how repeated token transfers plus skim() can manipulate pair balances/reserves before swapping back. While the PoC is short, reproducing it still requires protocol-specific reasoning about UniswapV2-style accounting rather than an obvious access-control or basic reentrancy bug.
